verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published expected timelines: it gives neither Founder Law's own preparation time nor the USCIS processing times its cases depend on. The items that come closest are a mention that premium processing is included in the fee, a promise to tell clients which pathways 'fit your timeline' during a consultation, and a 30-month parole status length. These are adjacent pricing or advisory features, not published timeline estimates.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on
